entities.name: Giardino Botanico Alpino alle Viotte di Monte Bondone
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Viote Alpine Botanical Garden is an alpine botanical garden operated by the Museo tridentino di scienze naturali, and located in Viotte di Monte Bondone, southwest of Trento, Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol, Italy. It is open daily in the warmer months; an admission fee is charged.
